record.t: Announced, with others, the launch of a statewide survey on technology-use policies in North Dakota classrooms.
record.q: Lt. Gov. Michelle Strinden and North Dakota First Lady Kjersti Armstrong today announced the launch of a statewide survey designed to gather public input on responsible technology‑use policies in North Dakota classrooms.
